name: CFE-CMStatistics 2026
edition: 20th International Joint Conference on Computational and Financial Econometrics (CFE) and Computational and Methodological Statistics (CMStatistics)
organizer: CFEnetwork and CMStatistics; hosted by HTW Berlin
venue: HTW Berlin, University of Applied Sciences, Wilhelminenhof campus
call_type: Abstracts (contributed talks; invited and organized sessions)
deadline_note: Closed. Contributed abstracts: "10th September 2026" (extended deadline); invited/organized session abstracts: 15 July 2026. Optional full papers by 28 February 2027.
submission_requirements: Abstract submission online; presenting authors must register by 12 September 2026 (extended) to be included in the programme; in-person or virtual participation.
registration_fee: Academic EUR 440 early (to 1 Jul 2026) / 470 standard (to 15 Sep) / 580 late (to 16 Nov) / 690 last minute; students EUR 340/440/580/690; non-academic EUR 540/570/680/790; tutorials EUR 85-125. Same fee in person or virtual.
notification_date: At most two weeks after submission
